description: Source code for 'mtd', a tool for manipulating Memory Technology Devices (MTD). It includes functions for opening, checking, erasing, writing, verifying, and dumping MTD devices, as well as command-line interface handling for various operations like erase, write, verify, and reboot.

methods.name: mtd_open
methods.description: Opens an MTD device, trying to find the device node based on the provided label or path.

methods.name: mtd_check_open
methods.description: Checks and opens an MTD device, retrieves device info such as size and type.

methods.name: mtd_block_is_bad
methods.description: Checks if a block at a given offset is bad (for NAND flash).

methods.name: mtd_erase_block
methods.description: Erases a block at a specified offset.

methods.name: mtd_write_buffer
methods.description: Writes a buffer to the device at a specified offset.

methods.name: image_check
methods.description: Checks the magic number of an image file to determine its format.

methods.name: mtd_check
methods.description: Validates and opens the specified MTD device, handling multiple device nodes if needed.

methods.name: mtd_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the specified MTD device or partition.

methods.name: mtd_erase
methods.description: Erases the entire MTD device or partition.

methods.name: mtd_dump
methods.description: Outputs the contents of the MTD device to stdout.

methods.name: mtd_verify
methods.description: Verifies the device content against a given file using MD5 checksum.

methods.name: indicate_writing
methods.description: Displays status message indicating writing process.

methods.name: mtd_write
methods.description: Writes an image to the MTD device, handling partitioning, bad blocks, and optional FIS layout.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line tool.

methods.name: do_reboot
methods.description: Reboots the system via system call or shell command.
